# `model_catalog`

Serves an OpenAI-compatible `GET /v1/models` catalog filtered per principal.

## Configuration Notes

The proxy answers list (`GET {list_path}`) and lookup (`GET {list_path}/{id}`) requests itself. With `upstreams` configured, the models those upstreams report decide what exists: their `GET /v1/models` lists are fetched on first use and refreshed every `refresh_interval_secs` in the background, and an upstream that fails keeps its last known list. Configured `models` entries then only overlay client-facing IDs, aliases, and visibility; an entry no upstream reports is not listed. Without `upstreams`, the configured entries are the catalog. Each entry may restrict visibility to authenticated subjects, roles, or teams. Hidden and unknown models both return the same `404 model_not_found`, so callers cannot probe for models they cannot see. Model metadata is never declared in config: `created` and `owned_by` come from the upstream when it reports them, and the upstream's `provider` and an entry's aliases appear under a `praxis` key that OpenAI clients ignore. Anything the upstream does not report is omitted. Other paths pass through untouched.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `list_path` | string | no | Path serving the model list. `{list_path}/{id}` serves one model. |
| `default_visibility` | `public` \| `authenticated` | no | Who may see entries that have no `visible_to` rule. |
| `upstreams` | object[] | no | Upstream model list endpoints. When set, they decide which models exist and `models` entries only overlay IDs, aliases, and visibility. |
| `upstreams[].name` | string | yes | Name used in logs. |
| `upstreams[].url` | string | yes | Full URL of the upstream model list endpoint. |
| `upstreams[].provider` | string | no | Provider reported in catalog metadata for models this upstream lists. |
| `upstreams[].bearer_token_env_var` | string | no | Environment variable holding a token sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. |
| `upstreams[].headers` | object[] | no | Extra request headers, such as `anthropic-version`. |
| `upstreams[].headers[].name` | string | one of | Header name. |
| `upstreams[].headers[].value` | string | one of | Literal header value. |
| `upstreams[].headers[].name` | string | one of | Header name. |
| `upstreams[].headers[].value_env_var` | string | one of | Environment variable holding the header value. |
| `upstreams[].allow_private` | bool | no | Allow connecting to private, loopback, and link-local addresses. |
| `refresh_interval_secs` | integer | no | Seconds an upstream model list is served before it is refreshed. |
| `unconfigured_models` | `show` \| `hide` | no | Whether upstream models without a `models` entry are listed. |
| `models` | object[] | no | Catalog entries. IDs should be the client-facing model IDs that inference routing accepts. Required when `upstreams` is empty. |
| `models[].id` | string | yes | Client-facing model ID. |
| `models[].upstream_id` | string | no | ID the upstream reports for this model. Defaults to `id`. Only used with `upstreams`; the upstream ID itself is not listed. |
| `models[].aliases` | string[] | no | Additional IDs listed as their own objects with the same visibility. |
| `models[].visible_to` | object | no | Restrict visibility to matching principals. Absent uses `default_visibility`. |
| `models[].visible_to.subjects` | string[] | no | Authenticated subject IDs. |
| `models[].visible_to.roles` | string[] | no | Authenticated roles. |
| `models[].visible_to.teams` | string[] | no | Authenticated teams. |
